pattern: group by entity, conditional sum and count, single-row share calculation
question: what percent of total donation value comes from people who gave more than once, and how many repeat donors are there
gold_sql: WITH counts AS (SELECT "Donor", COUNT(*) AS gifts, SUM("Amount") AS donor_total FROM donations GROUP BY "Donor") SELECT 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN gifts > 1 THEN donor_total ELSE 0 END) / SUM(donor_total) AS repeat_share_percent, SUM(CASE WHEN gifts > 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS repeat_donor_count FROM counts
sql_duckdb: WITH donor_counts AS (SELECT "Donor", COUNT(*) AS donation_count, SUM("Amount") AS total_amount FROM "donations" GROUP BY "Donor"), repeat_donors AS (SELECT "Donor", donation_count, total_amount FROM donor_counts WHERE donation_count > 1), totals AS (SELECT SUM(total_amount) AS repeat_amount, COUNT(*) AS repeat_donor_count, SUM(CASE WHEN donation_count > 1 THEN total_amount ELSE 0 END) AS all_repeat_amount, SUM(total_amount) OVER () AS grand_total FROM donor_counts) SELECT (SUM(CASE WHEN donation_count > 1 THEN total_amount ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(NULLIF(SUM(total_amount), 0), 0)) AS percent_from_repeat_donors, COUNT(CASE WHEN donation_count > 1 THEN 1 END) AS repeat_donor_count FROM donor_counts

CURRENT QUESTION:
what percent of total donation value comes from people who gave more than once, and how many repeat donors are there
attempts.response:
WITH donor_counts AS (
  SELECT "Donor", COUNT(*) AS donation_count, SUM("Amount") AS total_amount
  FROM "donations"
  GROUP BY "Donor"
),
repeat_donors AS (
  SELECT "Donor", donation_count, total_amount
  FROM donor_counts
  WHERE donation_count > 1
),
totals AS (
  SELECT 
    SUM(total_amount) AS repeat_amount,
    COUNT(*) AS repeat_donor_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN donation_count > 1 THEN total_amount ELSE 0 END) AS all_repeat_amount,
    SUM(total_amount) OVER () AS grand_total
  FROM donor_counts
)
SELECT 
  (SUM(CASE WHEN donation_count > 1 THEN total_amount ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(total_amount), 0)) AS percent_from_repeat_donors,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN donation_count > 1 THEN 1 END) AS repeat_donor_count
FROM donor_counts;
